scope: Second narrow exact-arithmetic performance slice: ancestor-prefix output domains on top of the previously validated zero-inertia elision. No solver, controller, physical gate or model changes.

change.method: For each link, preserve all six-term spatial reductions and link accumulation order while reducing only the output rows/columns to 0..assembly_id+joint.ndofs(). Verify every omitted Jacobian/Coriolis column is exactly zero; reject the fast path on nonfinite inputs, nonfinite output accumulators, or finite operands large enough for a spatial M*J intermediate to overflow. Keep original dense arithmetic on rejected inputs. Keep full Coriolis propagation, scratch, kinematic permutation and both LU factorizations.
change.twoDimensionalPath: Original arithmetic retained; prefix path enabled only in 3D.

preSimulationArithmeticProof.fixture: Synthetic branched 25-body assemblies with 9 massless frames and 3 fixed attachments; 27-DoF free root and 21-DoF fixed root; rotated/moving states, internal kinematic joint, passive diagonals, repeated updates.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.comparison: Bitwise equality against both the original dense implementation and the previously validated zero-inertia-only implementation.
comparedBits: both LU matrices and pivot sequences
preSimulationArithmeticProof.invalidOperands: NaN/Inf inputs, signed-zero suffixes and a confirmed finite M*J overflow case retain dense propagation bits. The overflow fixture explicitly checks an infinite intermediate and a NaN outside the retained prefix in the dense reference.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.rejectedFixtureCorrection: The first overflow setup used an inverse mass at Rapier's existing zero-inverse epsilon. Its failing assertion was retained, then the fixture was corrected to confirm real overflow; no production bound or acceptance criterion changed.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.note: Standalone pinned vendored-engine lock for unit arithmetic; native and WASM workspace builds separately checked.

nativeWorkspaceParity.comparison: Exact full JSON equality, no float tolerances
nativeWorkspaceParity.standingGate: All unchanged predicates at every 800 Hz sample from 0.5 s; no failures. Full cumulative loaded slip remains <=20 mm.

limits: This first prefix implementation is rejected for performance; functional chain was not run after the regression was confirmed.
Native candidate validation is bounded to 5 physical seconds per heading; prior 33 s long-hold proof is not relabeled as directly rerun here.
Existing broader native, ballistic, recovery, mobile and real-time release gaps remain.
rejectionReason: Exact physics parity passes, but actual browser forward/reverse pairs show a pooled 10.15% wall-time regression. Implementation is rejected pending a causal profile, not published as a performance gain.

causalProfile.finding: The smaller quadform becomes cheaper, but extra inlined checks in update_mass_matrix overwhelm it. Samples do not distinguish individual inlined source lines.
